points: Boil a half-full kettle. Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
Heat the butter (see pantry for amount) in a deep saucepan on medium heat. Once hot, add half the garlic and cook for 30 secs.
Stir in the rice and cook until coated, 1 min. Add ¼ tsp salt and the boiled water and cook for 10-12 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a sieve and pop back in the pan. Cover with a lid and leave to the side until ready to serve.
steps.title: Cook the Garlic Rice

points: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the diced chicken to the pan and season with salt and pepper.
Cook until browned all over, 5-6 mins. Turn occasionally.

notes.text: Notice a stronger smell from your chicken? Don’t worry, this is normal due to packaging we use to keep it fresh.
Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw chicken and its packaging.

steps.title: Brown the Chicken

points: Once the chicken has browned, add the tomato puree, korma curry paste and remaining garlic to the pan. Cook until fragrant, 1-2 mins.
Stir in the chicken stock paste and water for the curry (see pantry for amount). Bring to the boil, then lower the heat to medium and cover with a lid.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, 5-6 mins.

notes.text: The chicken is cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Add the Flavour

points: Remove the lid from the chicken curry and stir through the creme fraiche and honey (see pantry for amount).
Bring the curry to the boil, then add the spinach to the pan a handful at a time until wilted and piping hot, 1-2 mins.
steps.title: Wilt the Spinach

points: Taste the chicken curry and season with salt and pepper if needed.
Add a splash of water if it's a little too thick.
steps.title: Finishing Touches

points: When everything's ready, fluff up the buttery garlic rice with a fork and stir through the peas.
Share the garlic and pea rice between your bowls.
Top with the chicken korma style curry.
Sprinkle over the flaked almonds to finish.
steps.title: Serve Up
